details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (overall financial performance), K2 (revenue breakdown), K3 (installment loans launch), K4 (smartphone financing), K5 (Tanzania expansion), K7 (bond tap), K8 (major bond issuance), and K9 (dividend distribution). However, it omits the core material meaning of K6 (AI voice agents pilot), K10 (impairment expense details), K11 (regulatory challenge in Moldova), and K12 (post-reporting period funding). These omissions are significant as they involve HIGH importance items (K10, K11) and a MEDIUM importance item (K12), and the absence of K6 (MEDIUM) further reduces the completeness. While the main picture is captured, several important details are missing, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.

coherence_issues.description: Sentence S2 contains an apparent numerical inconsistency: it states revenues of 250.0 million euros represent a 15.4% increase compared to 2016.6 million euros reported in 2024. The comparative figure (2016.6 million) appears to be a typographical error since it is not a plausible monetary value (it should likely be 216.6 million euros to align with the stated percentage increase). However, this is not an internal contradiction per se, but rather a logical gap because the arithmetic relationship as presented does not compute correctly within the confines of the summary itself.

candidate_sentences.text: The company achieved record-high revenues of 250.0 million euros, representing a 15.4% increase compared to 2016.6 million euros reported in 2024.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear narrative structure covering financial performance, operational highlights, geographic expansion, and capital management. Most statements logically follow one another without internal contradictions. The only notable issue is in S2 where the percentage increase calculation does not align with the provided figures, creating a logical gap. This does not rise to the level of a self-contradiction because the summary does not explicitly assert that the arithmetic is correct; it merely reports the numbers and the percentage change. All other sentences contribute to a coherent whole without material contradictions, and there is no unnecessary repetition or organizational breakdown.
